description: This file implements the RenderMain class for a DirectX-based rendering component within a Windows application. It manages rendering a graph, handling user interactions, device events, and drawing nearest points or active tracing on a SwapChainPanel.

classes.name: RenderMain
classes.description: Main class responsible for rendering a graph and handling user interactions, device events, and rendering logic within a Windows app using DirectX.

methods.name: RenderMain::set
methods.description: Sets the graph to be rendered and configures its renderer with the current DPI and size.

methods.name: RenderMain::BackgroundColor::set
methods.description: Sets the background color for rendering based on a Windows::UI::Color object.

methods.name: RenderMain::DrawNearestPoint::set
methods.description: Enables or disables drawing of the nearest point.

methods.name: RenderMain::PointerLocation::set
methods.description: Updates the pointer location and triggers a render pass if needed.

methods.name: RenderMain::ActiveTracing::set
methods.description: Enables or disables active tracing and triggers a render pass if needed.

methods.name: RenderMain::ActiveTracing::get
methods.description: Returns whether active tracing is enabled.

methods.name: RenderMain::CreateWindowSizeDependentResources
methods.description: Adjusts rendering resources based on window size changes and initializes active tracing location.

methods.name: RenderMain::CanRenderPoint
methods.description: Determines if a point can be rendered based on current state and user interaction.

methods.name: RenderMain::GetPrecision
methods.description: Calculates the precision value for display ranges.

methods.name: RenderMain::SetPointRadius
methods.description: Sets the radius for rendering the nearest point.

methods.name: RenderMain::RunRenderPass
methods.description: Triggers a render pass.

methods.name: RenderMain::RunRenderPassAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a render pass, allowing for cancellation.

methods.name: RenderMain::RunRenderPassInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal logic of rendering and presents the frame.

methods.name: RenderMain::Render
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the current frame, including clearing the background, drawing the graph, and rendering nearest points or active tracing.

methods.name: RenderMain::GetRenderError
methods.description: Returns the HRESULT error code from the last render attempt.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for when the SwapChainPanel is loaded; triggers a render pass.

methods.name: RenderMain::RegisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Registers event handlers for window, display, and panel events.

methods.name: RenderMain::UnregisterEventHandlers
methods.description: Unregisters previously registered event handlers.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes of the window.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnDpiChanged
methods.description: Handles DPI changes and updates renderer accordingly.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnOrientationChanged
methods.description: Handles display orientation changes.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnDisplayContentsInvalidated
methods.description: Handles display invalidation events.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnCompositionScaleChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the composition scale of the SwapChainPanel.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size changes of the SwapChainPanel and updates renderer.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnDeviceLost
methods.description: Handles device loss events, releasing device-dependent resources.

methods.name: RenderMain::OnDeviceRestored
methods.description: Handles device restoration events, recreating device-dependent resources.
